items.summary: Recommendation: maintain the three-property Site Factory pipeline as readiness-only and launch-blocked. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, and existing ownership, compliance, security, measurement, and rollback evidence is incomplete. Do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics or affiliate systems, spend, add dependencies, or create queue work. Pipeline: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, driveford.net. Each packet will cover site brief, reusable template scope, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, security evidence, rollback point, and explicit launch disposition using existing records only.
